discovery: The holographic principle and its concrete realization in gauge/gravity (AdS/CFT) duality

nominees.name: Juan Maldacena
nominees.affiliation: Institute for Advanced Study, Princeton, USA

subfield: Theoretical physics: quantum gravity and string theory
motivation: Starting from the black hole information puzzle, 't Hooft and Susskind proposed that the physics of a gravitating region is encoded in degrees of freedom on its boundary, with entropy scaling as area rather than volume. Maldacena's 1997 discovery that string theory in anti-de Sitter space is exactly equivalent to a conformal gauge theory on its boundary turned this into a precise, testable framework. Holography established that black hole evaporation is unitary, showed that spacetime geometry can emerge from quantum entanglement, and recast the reconciliation of quantum mechanics with gravity as a well-posed problem. The duality is now an essential tool well beyond gravity: it led to the universal viscosity bound tested in heavy-ion collisions, to new approaches to strongly correlated electrons, and to the Page curve via quantum extremal surfaces. Few ideas of the last fifty years have changed so deeply how physicists think about space, time and information.
